To receive a list of all options for the keyword Agenda, type the following into the command line:
Typing the keyword Alert into the command line displays an alert message marked in red in the message center.
Pressing the button Preset twice takes over Attributes into the command line.
Attributes are organized by Features, which in turn are organized by PresetType. This means that you can also call attributes with the Feature and PresetType keyword using numbers separated by a dot.
Blackout is a toggle function. This means that entering Blackout without any helping keyword will toggle Blackout mode on/off.
If no attribute list is given, the ChannelLink mode will be Dimmer (fader controls the dimmer attributes of the current selection).
Typing the keyword Chat into the command line generates an information message marked in gray in the message center.
CircularCopy moves the attribute values within your currently selected fixtures in accordance with the selection order.
Depending on status of the programmer the function will sequentially:
Press the button Clear twice to inactivate all values.
Press the button Clear for slightly over two seconds to clear the selection and to discard all programmer values.
To clear the selection press the button Clear once.
Clone [Source Selection-list] At [Destination Selection-list] If [Scope Object-list]
As a helping keyword for programming functions (e.g., Store) this keyword sets the cmd delay time of the object in question.
Crossfade is a function that gradually activates the next step of an executor in accordance with the position of the fader.
CrossfadeA is a function that gradually fades down dimmer attributes of the current step of an executor in accordance with the position of the fader.
Depending on the executor option AB/Split this function will either act as a Crossfader for decreasing values or as a Master for the current cue (for dimmer attributes).
Cues are arranged in sequences and are divided in parts. If only cue ID is entered, you are applying functions to all parts of cues of the sequence assigned to the selected executor.
To access cues of unselected sequences/executors add a parent object to the syntax, i.e., Cue 3.001 Executor 1 or Sequence 5 Cue 3.999
DefGoBack calls the previous cue in the selected executor.
âDefGoForward calls the next cue in the selected executor.
DefGoPause pauses the current fade between cues and effects in the selected executor if the option "Link effect to rate" is on in the assign menu.
As a helping keyword for programming functions (e.g., Store) this keyword sets the time of an object.
Used as a starting keyword, Delay applies individual timing in the programmer for the current selection and attributes.
[Store / Copy / Delete] PMArea [pixel mapper area ID].[pixel mapper output ID] / [option]
Assign PMArea [pixel mapper area ID].[pixel mapper output ID] / [parameter] = [parameter value]
[Function] Profile [DMX Profile ID].[DMX Profile Point ID]

Assign Protocol [Network Protocol ID] . [Row ID] / [Parameter] = [Parameter Value]
Assign Remote [Remote Input Type ID] . [ID] / [Parameter] = [Parameter Value]
If you store a remote input type, the IDs needs to be in an order and beginning from 1.

Search [ search for objects] ( At [search values] ) If [ search in objects]
